title: 高盛卡普兰：点阵图可能过时，市场需谨慎解读
speaker: Rob Kaplan

segments.en: Well, here's the caution. And obviously I submitted a lot of these SCPs when I was at the Fed.
segments.zh: 这里要谨慎。显然我在美联储时提交了很多这样的SCP。

segments.en: You get it ready to submit by Thursday Friday of last week. It's announced over the weekend and clear the war is coming to an end. The straight is being reopened and you've already done all your work.
segments.zh: 你上周四、五准备好提交，周末宣布战争即将结束，海峡重新开放，而你已经完成了所有工作。

segments.en: And so could I imagine that if that dot plot was done six weeks from now, you won't get another one until September that it might be softer than the rate path than nine that are suggesting.
segments.zh: 所以我能想象，如果点阵图是在六周后做的，下一次要到9月，它可能比现在暗示的利率路径更温和。

segments.en: That's possible because you've got a lot changing right now. And if I were in my former seat, I would be urging caution about over interpreting this dot plot because we just had a big change.
segments.zh: 这有可能，因为现在很多事情在变。如果我在原来的位置，我会敦促谨慎解读这个点阵图，因为我们刚刚经历了一个重大变化。

segments.en: And so that's a caution on this and the market only is just reacting to the data it has.
segments.zh: 所以对此要谨慎，市场只是对现有数据做出反应。

segments.en: And I think it's worth noting that there ought to be a significant caution on interpreting this dot plot.
segments.zh: 我认为值得注意的是，解读这个点阵图应该非常谨慎。
